multiDrawChatDelivery.title: Multi-draw notification mode
multiDrawChatDelivery.description: Choose how multi-draw gacha results are posted to chat. Existing behavior remains one summary message by default.
multiDrawChatDelivery.summaryDescription: Keep the existing behavior and post the whole multi-draw result as one chat message.
multiDrawChatDelivery.individual: Send one card at a time
multiDrawChatDelivery.individualDescription: Post each card separately at about 1.6-second intervals. A 15-draw result takes about 22 seconds to finish.
multiDrawChatDelivery.chunked: Send a few cards at a time
multiDrawChatDelivery.chunkedDescription: Group several cards per message and post the groups at about 1.6-second intervals.
multiDrawChatDelivery.loadError: Could not load the multi-draw notification mode.
multiDrawChatDelivery.saveError: Could not save the multi-draw notification mode.
multiDrawChatDelivery.pacingNote: Split notifications use about 1.6 seconds between posts to stay comfortably within Twitch chat pacing limits.
